notizie.titolo: FSB Regional Consultative Group for Asia meets in Sydney
notizie.descrizione: Reserve Bank of Australia hosts FSB Asia group in Sydney.

notizie.titolo: FSB publishes 2026 list of insurers subject to resolution standards
notizie.descrizione: List of insurers subject to resolution standards rises from 17 to 24.

notizie.titolo: FSB sets out its priorities for 2027
notizie.descrizione: FSB members met in Basel to discuss vulnerabilities in the global financial system and the FSB work programme for 2027.

notizie.titolo: Virtual outreach event on FSB Regulatory and Supervisory Modernisation Principles
notizie.descrizione: The FSB will host a virtual outreach event on its proposed principles to assist financial authorities in their modernisation efforts on Tuesday 15 December.

notizie.titolo: Further work by jurisdictional authorities and private sector necessary to enhance cross-border payments
notizie.descrizione: Meaningful progress toward the G20 Roadmap’s goals will depend on effective jurisdictional implementation, public-private coordination, and sustained support from international organisations.

notizie.titolo: G20 Roadmap for Enhancing Cross-border Payments: Consolidated progress report for 2026
notizie.descrizione: Implementation of the toolkits and recommendations developed under the G20 Roadmap for Enhancing Cross-border Payments is progressing, but continued efforts by the public and private sector are required.

notizie.titolo: Financial stability in a rapidly changing world
notizie.descrizione: FSB Chair, Andrew Bailey, discusses the importance of transparency and cooperation in managing systemic risks at the IOSCO Conference celebrating 25 years of standard setting from Madrid.

notizie.titolo: FSB recommends Türkiye further strengthens its regulatory framework for crypto-assets and stablecoins
notizie.descrizione: Türkiye should operationalise a financial stability monitoring framework, establish a regime for stablecoins, strengthen supervision and enforcement, and promote cross-border cooperation and information sharing.
Peer review assesses Türkiye’s progress in implementing the FSB recommendations for the regulation and supervision of crypto-asset activities, including stablecoins.

notizie.titolo: FSB Regional Consultative Group for Europe meets in Bern
notizie.descrizione: Swiss National Bank hosts the FSB Europe group in Bern.
